test_title: PYST 38: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question, select the missing number of the given series.

5, 9, 17, 33, 65, ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

5 + 22 = 5 + 4 = 9

9 + 23 = 9 + 8 = 17

17 + 24 = 17 + 16 = 33

33 + 25 = 33 + 32 = 65

65 + 26 = 65 + 64 = 129

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/beea90acd8468d67ff93cb94eefdba34add207ab9cef92417c2e3d46306d89e5.png] 

Hence, '**129**' is the correct answer.
